rows.name: a manifest's delegate settings bring their builtin
a run waiting on a person exits 2 and resumes once answered
login saves a checked key readable only by its owner
run --stateless answers in one call and leaves no agent; runs get reads it back
the CLI deploys a manifest, runs its agent, and manages agents and definitions
the CLI reads the runtime's URL from CAMELAI_BASE_URL, as the SDKs do, or CAMELAI_URL
the MCP server deploys and runs agents for a coding agent
an account's export holds its journey: what this runtime kept and what the store holds; an account journey never knew has none
an email sign-up is an account made when its mailed link is finished, in the browser that finishes it
a runtime with journey events off serves the console as ever: no tag, no cookie, no endpoint
with journey events on, an arrival is noted through the redirect, the browser gets its visitor id, and the console's pages reach the store
with journey events on, making an agent and running it tells the store of the agent, the day's activity and the account's first run
public accounts can email their verified address and cannot email strangers or suppressed recipients
a calendar wake-up tells the model its fixed local edition date
calendar schedules and owner-configured email round trip through the API without crossing accounts
a runtime bootstrapped from AGENT_TENANT and AGENT_OPERATOR_TOKEN serves that tenant
on a runtime configured by AGENT_TENANT, a run without a model key also names AGENT_TENANT_API_KEYS
a private runtime names no URL to browsers: AGENT_BROWSER_URL overrides the browser token's url, or empty leaves it out, and links carry their path on the runtime
workspaces API validates ownership, inherits definitions, and accounts agent and stateless model calls
